changelog: **Follow-up panel in the programme's own words (#2875):** the "Next step" field no longer suggests *Call about pricing* on an internship record — the base dictionary carries an internship example and the MARKETING overlay keeps the sales one. The panel now says who reads the note (the owning mentor and the admins; never the mentee; the owner is reminded by e-mail on the day), offers two or three ready-made lines per canonical stage as one-click chips (`src/lib/nextStepSuggestions.ts`, EN/TR/DE, unit-tested against the pipeline catalogue and the chip width), and — for a record with a logged interaction — a *Suggest with AI* button that asks for three lines from the log and the stage through the usual gate (new task `next_step_suggest`, `POST /api/mentorship/[id]/next-step`: owner or admin, the mentee's `AI_INTERACTION_SUMMARY` consent, monthly quota, 10/10 min, 1-day artefact cache keyed on log + stage + note + day in stage). Everything only fills the field; Save is still the owner's click.

en: The follow-up field on a mentee's record now speaks your language: an internship example instead of a sales one, a line that says who sees the note (you and the admins — never the mentee), ready-made next steps for the current stage you can click into the field, and a one-click AI suggestion based on the interaction log.
tr: Mentee kaydındaki takip alanı artık senin dilinde: satış değil staj örneği, notu kimin gördüğünü söyleyen bir satır (sen ve yöneticiler — mentee asla), bulunulan aşamaya göre tıklayınca alana dolan hazır adımlar ve etkileşim kaydına dayanan tek tıklık AI önerisi.
de: Das Wiedervorlage-Feld auf dem Datensatz eines Mentees spricht jetzt deine Sprache: ein Praktikumsbeispiel statt eines Verkaufsbeispiels, eine Zeile, wer die Notiz sieht (du und die Admins — nie der Mentee), fertige nächste Schritte zur aktuellen Phase per Klick ins Feld und ein KI-Vorschlag auf Basis des Interaktionsprotokolls.
